Documentation

Welcome to the AI Teacher Toolkit! This production-ready Next.js application is designed for educators and institutions. It's built with modern technologies, a premium UI, and is fully white-labelable for your own brand.

Step-by-Step Installation

Setting up the toolkit on your local machine is simple. Follow these steps to get started:

1
Extract and Open Unzip the downloaded package and open the folder in your code editor (e.g., VS Code).
2
Install Dependencies Open your terminal and run the following command to install all necessary packages. 
npm install
3
Configure Environment Copy the example environment file to create your local settings. 
cp .env.example .env.local
4
Launch App Start the development server. 
npm run dev
The app will be available at http://localhost:3000.

Deploy on Vercel

The fastest way to put your toolkit online is using Vercel. It is perfectly optimized for Next.js.

1
GitHub Repository Create a private repository on GitHub and push your extracted code to it.
2
Link to Vercel Login to Vercel, click "Add New" → "Project", and import your repository.
3
Environment Variables Under the "Environment Variables" section, add a new key named GROQ_API_KEY with your secret key as the value.
4
Deploy! Click "Deploy". Your toolkit will be live on a secure HTTPS domain in approximately 2 minutes.

Add API Key

This application uses Groq Cloud for lightning-fast AI responses. You need a free API key to power the tools.

You can generate your key for free at console.groq.com

Navigate to .env.local and paste your key:

GROQ_API_KEY=gsk_your_actual_key_here
Security Note: Never share your .env.local file or commit it to a public GitHub repository.

Customize Branding

We designed this toolkit to be 100% white-label. You can change the name, logo, and identity in a single file.

Open src/config/app.ts to modify the metadata:

Property Description Location
name The main title of your app. Header, Title Tag
orgName Your institution's name. PDF/Exports, Footer
logo Path to your transparent logo. Sidebar, Mobile Nav
description SEO description of the toolkit. Meta Tags

Replacing Logos:

Navigate to /public and replace the default images:

  • logo.png - Primary app logo.
  • favicon.ico - Browser tab icon.
  • og-image.png - Social media preview image.

Troubleshooting

Common issues and how to solve them effectively:

?
"Error: Groq API key not found" Ensure your variable name is exactly GROQ_API_KEY and it is defined in .env.local for local dev or Vercel settings for production.
?
"Images are not loading" Wait for the AI to finish generating. Some regions may have slower access to Pollinations.ai. Ensure your CSP headers allow https://pollinations.ai.
?
"PDF Export looks different" PDFs are generated using html2canvas. For the best result, ensure you are using a modern browser (Chrome/Edge/Safari).
?
"Node version mismatch" This project requires Node 18+. Check your version with node -v and upgrade if necessary using NVM.
